instruction: You are a strategic corporate innovation advisor conducting a reassessment. Analyse the prior assessment summary, changes since last assessment, and updated survey, then respond with a complete reassessment JSON including score_delta, carry_forward, progress, and comparison_to_previous.

answers.companyDescription: Multi-brand online marketplace aggregating 300+ independent Portuguese artisan brands across fashion, home decor, and gourmet food categories. Dropship and marketplace model with centralized logistics for top sellers. Seeking to implement AI-powered visual search and dynamic pricing. We operate across multiple geographies and business units with a matrix organizational structure. A centralized digital transformation office coordinates innovation initiatives, but business unit autonomy means adoption varies significantly. Annual capex budget for innovation exists but deployment is gated by rigorous ROI modeling and steering committee approval.
answers.pastInitiatives: We have not undertaken any systematic innovation or transformation programs. Our operational model has been largely unchanged for several years. While leadership acknowledges the need to modernize, we have not yet allocated resources, defined ownership, or committed to a timeline for any specific innovation initiative.
answers.strategicGoals: We are targeting a 20% improvement in operational throughput without increasing headcount. Our processes have grown organically over the years and are overdue for standardization. We suspect that workflow digitization, basic automation, and better data integration between our core systems can unlock significant productivity gains within our current cost structure.
answers.teamSize: Our digital and innovation organization includes 80+ professionals across centers of excellence for AI/ML, cloud engineering, UX design, and agile delivery. We run an internal incubator program that has graduated 6 new digital products to market in the past 2 years, alongside a corporate venture capital arm that makes strategic minority investments in relevant startups.

input.changes_since_last: Hired 7 new team members. Launched customer feedback pilot. Budget for innovation increased 10%.

opportunities.title: Enterprise Process Standardization and Workflow Digitization Layer
opportunities.rationale: The current model relies on organic, undocumented processes across decentralized business units. To achieve the 20% throughput goal, a standardized, digitized layer is required to break down siloed operations and ensure predictable performance scaling.

first_actions: Select 2-3 high-volume, cross-functional processes (e.g., inventory reconciliation, order fulfillment) for initial mapping.
Establish a 'Process Ownership' council with representation from key business units to mandate standardization.
Utilize process mining tools to identify undocumented bottlenecks and dependencies.
execution_plan.success_metric: Completion of standardized workflow blueprints for 5 critical business processes.
milestones: Standardization adoption rate tracked across pilot BUs (>70%)

opportunities.title: AI-Powered Dynamic Pricing and Visual Search Ecosystem
opportunities.rationale: Leveraging the highly skilled CoE talent (AI/ML, Cloud), Aether can move beyond basic automation to implement advanced predictive capabilities. This will require a radical overhaul of product display and pricing logic across all 300+ brands.

first_actions: Integrate historical sales data with external market trend APIs (competitor/seasonal).
Develop and train initial machine learning models for price elasticity testing and visual search tagging.
Run a closed-loop A/B test group on dynamic pricing in one controlled marketplace vertical.
resources_needed: Cloud compute credits for model training
execution_plan.success_metric: Measurable lift in Average Order Value (AOV) and conversion rate due to dynamic pricing implementation.
milestones: Rollout across 2 major business unit verticals

next_steps.action: Establish a cross-functional Process Governance Steering Committee (PCSC) with mandatory representation from Operations and Technology to mandate standardization adherence.
Execute a deep dive into the technical feasibility of unifying product data schemas across all 300+ brands to support AI ingestion.
Formalize change management training focusing on 'process literacy' for mid-level managers, addressing cultural resistance to standardization.

key_weaknesses: Lack of standardized process documentation across organically grown business units (Process Barrier)
Siloed adoption and decentralized execution, despite centralized CDTO efforts (Cultural Adoption Gap)
Decision-making remains gated by formal committee approval, slowing radical initiatives (Governance Friction)

improvements: Increased innovation budget allocation (14% to 19%) provides greater financial headroom.
Hiring 7 new team members and expanding digital talent base strengthens execution capacity.
Pilot customer feedback launched formalizes the initial capture of user needs.
persistent_gaps: The underlying operational processes remain undocumented and inconsistent, preventing true scalability.
Cultural inertia remains high; teams are comfortable with current 'good enough' manual workarounds.
Governance structure (formal committee) is still the primary bottleneck for rapid, cross-departmental change.
achieved_milestones: Increased financial commitment to innovation initiatives.
Strengthened internal digital talent pool and capability.

comparison_to_previous.key_changes: Significant improvement in resources (budget, talent) and formalization of efforts (pilot launch). Focus has shifted from recognizing potential to addressing deep systemic operational inefficiencies.
